title: Embeddings and Vectorstores
summary: This module provides functionalities for generating text embeddings and storing them in vector databases. It includes tools for creating, managing, and querying vector stores, as well as caching embedding results.

nodes.label: Initialize Embeddings
nodes.title: Initialize Embeddings
nodes.description: Dynamically initializes an embedding model from a given model name and optional provider, supporting various external embedding services.

nodes.label: Cache Backed Embeddings
nodes.title: Cache Backed Embeddings
nodes.description: Provides an interface for caching embedding results from underlying embedding models, improving performance by reducing redundant computations.

nodes.label: Vectorstore Index Creator
nodes.title: Vectorstore Index Creator
nodes.description: Facilitates the creation of vector store indexes from documents or loaders, handling text splitting and embedding generation.

nodes.label: Qdrant Vector Store
nodes.title: Qdrant Vector Store
nodes.description: Integrates with Qdrant, a vector similarity search engine, allowing for efficient storage, retrieval, and management of vector embeddings.

nodes.label: Fireworks Embeddings
nodes.title: Fireworks Embeddings
nodes.description: Provides an integration for generating embeddings using Fireworks AI models.

nodes.label: Text Splitter
nodes.title: Text Splitter
nodes.description: A utility for splitting large texts into smaller, manageable chunks suitable for embedding.

nodes.label: Base Loader
nodes.title: Base Loader
nodes.description: An abstract base class for loading documents from various sources.

nodes.label: Byte Store
nodes.title: Byte Store
nodes.description: An interface for storing and retrieving byte sequences, used for caching serialized embeddings.

nodes.label: Qdrant Client
nodes.title: Qdrant Client
nodes.description: The client library for interacting with the Qdrant vector database.

groups.label: Embedding Creation
groups.title: Embedding Creation
groups.description: Components responsible for generating vector embeddings from text.

groups.label: Vector Storage and Indexing
groups.title: Vector Storage and Indexing
groups.description: Components for storing, indexing, and managing vector embeddings in databases.

groups.label: Caching and Optimization
groups.title: Caching and Optimization
groups.description: Components focused on improving performance through caching of embedding results.
